summary_markdown:
The team discussed the necessity of recalculating metrics using updated inventory data, specifically from VA to traffic. This recalculation must be completed by Thursday to address pending inventory changes.

A key dependency for proceeding with inventory updates is receiving expected angle data from the client; without it, no inventory changes can be made.

The immediate goal was to deploy new data today, but there were also algorithmic changes required for the recalculation. A decision was reached regarding the deployment strategy: instead of repeatedly moving stages (like Brazil) to production for version control, the team agreed that if the results from the new algorithm are poor, they would recalculate using the old algorithm and perform a single final deployment to production.

The recalculated data needs to be deployed this week due to upcoming absences.
decisions: Recalculation of metrics must use updated inventory data by Thursday.
Deployment strategy: If new algorithmic results are poor, recalculate using the old algorithm and deploy once to production.
action_items: Complete all pending inventory changes and recalculations by Thursday.
Run the recalculation on the staging environment; if successful, deploy to production in the evening.
